finding.prior_gap: The initial fixed-horizon ledger allowed source_registry=None and only checked that feature_snapshot.sha256 looked like a 64-character hexadecimal digest. It could mark source_registry_status=NOT_CHECKED while still allowing outcome metrics to be computed.
finding.correction: PR #1470 now requires hash-bearing source registry entries, ties feature_snapshot.source_id to source_ids, compares the registered content hash to the snapshot SHA-256, registers outcome price sources and blocks all performance metrics for unverified provenance.

unresolved.live_vs_replay: Not yet implemented. Backdated issuance can still be represented unless a trusted append-time timestamp and explicit replay mode are added.
unresolved.model_hash: Model artifact/configuration hash not yet mandatory.
unresolved.baseline_hash: Baseline artifact/configuration hash not yet mandatory.
